ios.desc:
ScheduleMessages - Never forget to send important messages!

Get reminders at the perfect time to send your messages. Schedule texts for birthdays, appointments, or any occasion - the app will notify you when it's time to send.

NEW IN 3.0 – MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
• Unfolded: your messages and their details side by side
• Folded: everything fits the compact display
• 11 new languages – the app now speaks 45
• Recommend the app to a friend right after a birthday greeting

KEY FEATURES:

Message Scheduling
• Set date and time for your message reminders
• Get notified when it's time to send
• Quick scheduling options (in 5 min, 1 hour, tomorrow)
• Edit or reschedule anytime
• Repeat messages daily, weekly, monthly or yearly

Siri & Shortcuts
• Say "Schedule a message with ScheduleMessages"
• Siri asks for the recipient, the time and the text
• Recognizes your contacts and picks their usual messenger
• Also available as an action in the Shortcuts app

Birthday Calendar
• View all upcoming birthdays from your contacts
• Schedule birthday messages directly from the calendar
• See who has a birthday today, this week, or this month
• Never miss a birthday again

Three Ways to Organize
• Messages: All your scheduled messages in one place
• Favorites: Mark important messages with a heart
• Archive: Keep sent messages for future reference

Flexible Messaging
• Works with SMS and iMessage
• Support for WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal links
• Choose from your contacts or enter number manually
• Add contact name for manual entries

International Support
• Available in 45 languages
• Supports international phone numbers
• Clean, intuitive interface

Additional Features
• Dark mode support
• iCloud backup & sync
• Import/export messages
• Customizable default messenger
• Privacy-focused: all data stored locally

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Create a message with recipient and text
2. Set the date and time
3. Get a notification at the scheduled time
4. Tap to open your messaging app and send

PERFECT FOR:
• Birthday and anniversary wishes
• Business appointment reminders
• Medication reminders
• Following up with clients
• International messages across time zones

IMPORTANT NOTE:
Due to iOS security restrictions, the app cannot send messages automatically. You'll receive a notification and can send the message with one tap. This ensures your privacy and security.

No account required. No ads. Your data stays on your device.
